A profile can add its own lists, leave out the default block lists or turn blocking off entirely. The $client modifier also works in lists.

All apps ship with ZenitiumDNS and are updated with every package update. They stay disabled until you enable them here; you can adjust the configuration before enabling.

Misst jede Sekunde CPU, Arbeitsspeicher,: Measures CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread pool, queues and pending resolutions every second and keeps the last 5 minutes in memory. The overhead is negligible; when turned off, nothing is measured.
Prüft alle 10 Sekunden. Wächst die heuti: Checks every 10 seconds. If today's log file grows beyond 512 MB, it pauses query logging until midnight while errors and events are still logged. If disk space runs low, it pauses file logging until midnight and deletes older log files. On memory pressure it trims the cache, it empties an overflowing statistics queue, gives a starved thread pool more threads, and restarts missing DNS services up to three times. Every intervention is recorded in the log and in the self-test.
Legt fest, ob der Resolver Nameserver üb: Defines whether the resolver queries name servers over IPv6.
Alle ausgehenden DNS- und HTTP(S)-Anfrag: All outgoing DNS and HTTP(S) requests use IPv4 only.
IPv4 und IPv6 werden gleichwertig genutz: IPv4 and IPv6 are used equally. Name servers are selected by measured response time and answer rate.
IPv6-Adressen werden zuerst versucht, IP: IPv6 addresses are tried first, IPv4 serves as fallback.
IPv6 bei Störungen automatisch aussetzen: Suspend IPv6 automatically when it fails
Häufen sich Zeitüberschreitungen über IP: If timeouts over IPv6 pile up, the resolver pauses outgoing IPv6 queries and uses IPv4 only. It then regularly checks the IPv6 root servers to see whether IPv6 works again and resumes it automatically. The pause starts at one minute and doubles on repeated failures up to a maximum of 30 minutes.
<b>Hinweis:</b> Ohne native IPv6-Anbindu: Note: Without native IPv6 connectivity, IPv6 should stay disabled. With automatic fallback enabled, missing or broken IPv6 connectivity no longer causes bursts of SERVFAIL responses, but detecting it costs a few timeouts.
Nur nötig, wenn der Server in mehreren N: Only needed if the server is attached to several networks and outgoing queries should use a specific address.
Eine Adresse oder ein Netz pro Zeile. Di: One address or network per line. The addresses must be configured on a local interface and a matching route must exist.
Wie oben, für IPv6. Wird nur verwendet,: As above, for IPv6. Only used if IPv6 is enabled for outgoing queries.
Maximale UDP-Antwortgröße. Größere Antwo: Maximum UDP response size. Larger responses are answered with the TC bit set so that the client switches to TCP. 1232 bytes reliably avoid IP fragmentation.
Anzahl der Threads, die parallel UDP-Anf: Number of threads that receive UDP queries in parallel per local endpoint. 0 automatically uses the number of CPU cores, at most 8. A change restarts the DNS service.
Sendepuffer der UDP-Sockets, gilt für UD: Send buffer of the UDP sockets, applies to UDP and UDP-PROXY.
Empfangspuffer der UDP-Sockets. Unter ho: Receive buffer of the UDP sockets. Under high load, a larger buffer prevents queries from being dropped during load peaks.
UDP-Socket-Pool für ausgehende Anfragen: Use UDP socket pool for outgoing queries
Ausgehende UDP-Anfragen nutzen zufällige: Outgoing UDP queries use random source ports from a pool. On Linux the ports are already random enough; the resolver detects spoofing attempts anyway and then switches to TCP.
Portnummern, eine pro Zeile, die der Soc: Port numbers, one per line, that the socket pool must never use.
Grenzen für eingehende Verbindungen. Sie: Limits for incoming connections. They protect a public resolver against resource exhaustion.
So lange wartet der Server auf eine Aufl: How long the server waits for a resolution before answering the client with SERVFAIL (or with stale data, see Cache).
Maximale Dauer für das Senden einer Antw: Maximum time for sending a response over TCP, TLS, TCP-PROXY or HTTPS.
Maximale Wartezeit auf Daten über TCP, T: Maximum time to wait for data over TCP, TLS, TCP-PROXY or HTTPS; after that the connection is closed.
Maximal gleichzeitig in Bearbeitung befi: Maximum number of queries processed concurrently per TCP, TLS or PROXY connection (pipelining according to RFC 7766). Further queries on the same connection are only read once slots become free.
Nach dieser Zeit ohne Aktivität wird ein: A QUIC connection is closed after this time without activity.
Maximale Anzahl gleichzeitiger bidirekti: Maximum number of concurrent bidirectional streams per QUIC connection.
Maximale Anzahl wartender eingehender Ve: Maximum number of pending incoming connections for TCP, TLS, TCP-PROXY and QUIC.
Obergrenze für parallel laufende ausgehe: Upper limit for concurrent outgoing resolutions per CPU core. Beyond that, queries are answered with SERVFAIL instead of overloading the server.
Legt fest, wer den Server als rekursiven: Defines who may use the server as a recursive resolver. The RD flag of the query is decisive, even if forwarders are configured.
Der Server beantwortet nur noch Anfragen: The server only answers queries for forwarder zones and local records.
Öffentlicher Resolver: Jeder darf belieb: Public resolver: anyone may resolve any name. Be sure to configure rate limiting to curb abuse for amplification attacks.
Rekursive Anfragen aus öffentlichen Netz: Recursive queries from public networks are answered with REFUSED.
Die folgende Liste bestimmt, welche Netz: The following list determines which networks may use recursion.
One IP address or network per line. A leading ! denies access, e.g. !192.168.10.0/24. The list is evaluated from top to bottom; if no entry matches, access is denied. Loopback addresses are always allowed.
Verhalten des rekursiven Resolvers gegen: Behavior of the recursive resolver towards authoritative name servers.
Übermittelt jedem Nameserver nur den Tei: Sends each name server only the part of the name it needs for its answer (RFC 9156). This improves user privacy.
Nameserver ohne korrekte Minimierung mer: Remember name servers without correct minimization
Beantwortet ein Nameserver eine minimier: If a name server answers a minimized query incorrectly (for example with NXDOMAIN, an error or not at all) and the full name works afterwards, the resolver queries this zone with the full name right away for one hour. This saves one round trip per query with faulty name servers. On by default; flushing the cache resets the list. Currently remembered: 0 zones.
Zufällige Groß-/Kleinschreibung im Namen: Random upper and lower case in the name makes cache poisoning over UDP harder (draft-vixie-dnsext-dns0x20). On by default. If a name server answers with a different case, the resolver repeats the query over TCP, so faulty name servers remain reachable.
Schützt vor gefälschten Antworten und vo: Protects against forged responses and against the abuse of spoofed source addresses (RFC 7873, RFC 9018). On by default. The resolver sends name servers a cookie and discards responses with a wrong cookie; clients receive a server cookie. A client that sends a valid server cookie over UDP has proven its address and falls under the TCP limits of the rate limiting; rate-limited clients with a cookie receive BADCOOKIE with a new cookie instead of a TC response.
Beantwortet private Reverse-Zonen und Sp: Answers private reverse zones and special-use domains such as localhost or .local locally (RFC 6303, RFC 6761) instead of sending them to the root servers. To resolve such a domain externally, create a forwarder zone for it.
32 Hexadezimalzeichen. Nur nötig, wenn m: 32 hexadecimal characters. Only needed when several servers answer under the same anycast address: enter the same secret everywhere so that every server accepts a server cookie. If the field is empty, a new secret is created at every start.
Anzahl der Versuche je Nameserver. Bei N: Number of attempts per name server. For name servers without EDNS support the number can double because the query is also sent without an OPT record.
Wartezeit auf die Antwort eines Nameserv: Time to wait for a name server's answer before the next attempt starts.
Wie viele Nameserver einer Zone gleichze: How many name servers of a zone are queried at the same time. The fastest valid answer wins. The resolver continuously learns which name servers answer quickly and reliably and prefers them; slow or faulty ones are deprioritized.
Obergrenze für verschachtelte Auflösunge: Upper limit for nested resolutions, for example when resolving name server addresses without glue.
Alle Antworten der Nameserver bzw. Forwa: All answers from name servers or forwarders are verified cryptographically. Tampered answers are rejected with SERVFAIL.
Unterstützt werden auch post-quanten-sic: Post-quantum signatures with ML-DSA-44 (algorithm 18) are supported as well. If the parent zone announces ML-DSA-44 via its DS record, the zone must be validly signed with ML-DSA-44; an additional classic signature alone is then no longer sufficient. This prevents an attacker with a broken RSA or ECDSA key from bypassing the stronger signature.
Der Resolver merkt sich validierte NSEC-: The resolver keeps validated NSEC and NSEC3 records of signed zones and uses them to answer queries for names or types that do not exist there with NXDOMAIN or NODATA itself, without asking the authoritative servers again. This speeds up negative answers and slows down attacks with random subdomains. Such answers carry Extended DNS Error 29 (Synthesized). NSEC3 with opt-out, wildcards and names below forwarder zones are excluded. Only works with DNSSEC validation enabled.
<b>Achtung:</b> Geräte ohne Echtzeituhr: Warning: Devices without a real-time clock (e.g. Raspberry Pi) cannot set their time via NTP after booting because validation fails due to the wrong time. The fix is a forwarder zone for the NTP domain (e.g. ntp.org) with forwarder this-server and DNSSEC validation turned off.
<b>Hinweis:</b> Mit Forwardern funktioni: Note: With forwarders, validation only works if they pass DNSSEC records along correctly.
Nach RFC 8806 hält der Resolver eine eig: Following RFC 8806, the resolver keeps its own copy of the root zone and the arpa zone from IANA. Delegations to top-level domains and reverse zones then come from memory, and queries for top-level domains that do not exist are answered by the resolver itself with NXDOMAIN including a signed NSEC proof. This saves the trips to the root servers, reveals no queries to them and keeps the resolver working even when the root servers are disrupted.
Vor der Nutzung wird jede Zone vollständ: Each zone is fully verified before use: the root zone via its ZONEMD digest and DNSSEC signatures, the arpa zone via the signatures of all records. A zone that fails verification is not used.
Automatisch von IANA laden und stündlich: Load automatically from IANA and update hourly
Aus, wie bisher die Root-Server fragen: Off, query the root servers as before
Aus, wie bisher die Nameserver fragen: Off, query the name servers as before
Die arpa-Zone enthält die Delegationen d: The arpa zone contains the delegations of reverse zones such as in-addr.arpa and ip6.arpa. It is verified using the DS record from the root zone.
Automatisch von IANA laden und täglich a: Load automatically from IANA and update daily
Die mit dem Paket ausgelieferte Datei ve: Use the file shipped with the package
Die Vertrauensanker sind der Ausgangspun: The trust anchors are the starting point of every DNSSEC validation. IANA publishes them in root-anchors.xml; the file is only accepted if its signature chains to the ICANN Root CA. This way the new anchors are available in time when the root zone rolls its key.
Übermittelt einen Teil der Client-Adress: Passes part of the client address to name servers so that CDNs return geographically suitable servers. Only useful if the resolver is far away from its users.
Verwendet das Subnetz der öffentlichen C: Uses the subnet of the public client address with the prefix length given below, or an ECS option already contained in the query.
Wird statt des tatsächlichen Client-Subn: Sent for all outgoing queries instead of the actual client subnet.
<b>Achtung:</b> ECS gibt Teile der Clien: Warning: ECS passes parts of the client address to third parties and thereby weakens privacy. Without encrypted protocols, the information is also visible to eavesdroppers.
<b>Hinweis:</b> Der Cache muss Antworten: Note: The cache has to keep answers separately per subnet. This considerably increases memory usage and cache misses.
Sind Forwarder eingetragen, löst der Ser: If forwarders are configured, the server no longer resolves via the root servers itself but forwards all queries to these servers. For individual domains, this can be controlled selectively with forwarder zones instead.
IP-Adressen oder URLs, eine pro Zeile, o: IP addresses or URLs, one per line, or pick them from the quick selection. For DNS-over-HTTPS/3 use the scheme h3:// instead of https://; there is no fallback to HTTP/2. The quick selection can be customized via www/json/readme.txt.
Mehrere Forwarder gleichzeitig befragen: Query several forwarders at the same time
Befragt mehrere Forwarder parallel und v: Queries several forwarders in parallel and uses the fastest answer. The selection is based on the measured response time; if none answers in time, the remaining ones are tried.
Anzahl der parallel befragten Forwarder: Number of forwarders queried in parallel when concurrent forwarding is enabled.
Versuche je Forwarder, gilt auch für Wei: Attempts per forwarder, also applies to forwarder zones.
Wartezeit auf die Antwort eines Forwarde: Time to wait for a forwarder's answer, also applies to forwarder zones.
TTL, die beim Anlegen oder Bearbeiten vo: TTL suggested when creating or editing records in forwarder zones if none is given.
Ist ein Proxy gesetzt, laufen alle ausge: If a proxy is set, all outgoing connections of the server go through it, including block list downloads. The automatic IPv6 fallback then has no effect.
IP-Adressen, Netze oder Domainnamen, die: IP addresses, networks or domain names that should never go through the proxy.
Kennung, die der Server bei allen HTTP-A: Identifier the server sends with every HTTP request: block lists, client block lists, IANA data, update check, forwarding over DNS-over-HTTPS and apps. Leave empty for the default. Useful when a list provider rejects unknown identifiers.
Ausgeschaltet speichert ZenitiumDNS kein: When turned off, ZenitiumDNS stores no answers: no cache, no prefetch, no serve stale, no aggressive use of NSEC and no local root and arpa zone; the existing cache is flushed and cache.bin is deleted. Every query goes to the forwarders or is resolved anew. Meant for running in front of a resolver with its own cache such as Unbound, so that nothing is cached twice; filters, block lists, client profiles and encrypted protocols keep working. Without forwarders every query is resolved starting at the root servers, which is slow. Identical concurrent queries are still merged.
Der Cache ist der wichtigste Hebel für k: The cache is the most important lever for short response times. The dashboard shows the hit rate.
Ein Eintrag ist ein vollständiges RRset,: An entry is a complete RRset, i.e. all records of one type for a name. When the limit is exceeded, the server regularly removes the least recently used entries. Choose the value based on the cache entries on the dashboard and the memory usage.
Überschreitet der belegte Arbeitsspeiche: When the server's used memory exceeds this value, the cache maintenance that runs every minute removes the least recently used entries until usage is back at about 90 % of the limit. At least 10,000 entries are kept. The limit covers all managed memory including block lists and statistics; the process usually occupies 30 to 60 % more in the system. Rule of thumb: about a third of the machine's memory.
Einträge mit kürzerer TTL bleiben mindes: Records with a shorter TTL stay in the cache at least this long.
Einträge mit längerer TTL werden spätest: Records with a longer TTL are resolved again after this time at the latest. One day matches Unbound and PowerDNS and limits how long changed or wrong records linger.
Cache-Dauer für <code>NXDOMAIN</code>- u: Cache duration for NXDOMAIN and NODATA responses if the zone does not provide an SOA minimum value.
Obergrenze für die Cache-Dauer von <code: Upper limit for the cache duration of NXDOMAIN and NODATA responses, even if the zone's SOA specifies a higher value. Newly created names thus become visible after this time at the latest. RFC 2308 recommends one to three hours, Unbound and PowerDNS use one hour.
Wie lange Fehlschläge (<code>SERVFAIL</c: How long failures (SERVFAIL, no answer) are cached. Prevents broken domains from hammering the name servers again and again.
Häufig abgefragte Einträge werden kurz v: Frequently queried records are renewed in the background shortly before they expire so that the cache stays warm and clients never wait for a new resolution.
Nur Einträge, deren ursprüngliche TTL mi: Only records whose original TTL is at least this value are renewed in advance.
Wird ein Eintrag abgefragt, dessen Rest-: When a record is queried whose remaining TTL is below this value, renewal starts immediately in the background.
% der ursprünglichen TTL (empfohlen 10,: % of the original TTL (recommended 10, 0 = seconds trigger only)
Ein Eintrag wird erneuert, sobald bei ei: A record is renewed as soon as only this share of its TTL is left when it is queried; with 10 % and a TTL of one hour, that is within the last 6 minutes. Frequently queried records thus stay in the cache without ever expiring. Only applies while prefetch with the seconds trigger is enabled.
Liefert abgelaufene Einträge aus, wenn d: Serves expired records when the name servers cannot be reached in time (RFC 8767). Considerably improves resilience when upstream connections are disrupted.
So lange bleiben abgelaufene Einträge im: How long expired records remain available in the cache. 1 to 3 days are recommended, 7 days at most.
TTL, mit der veraltete Einträge an den C: TTL with which stale records are sent to the client, i.e. how long the client caches them in turn.
Schlägt die Erneuerung fehl, gilt der ve: If renewal fails, the stale record is considered valid again for this time. This way the resolver does not try to refresh the record on every query.
Wartezeit auf eine frische Antwort, bevo: Time to wait for a fresh answer before the stale record is served. 0 answers immediately with the stale record and renews it in the background.
Speichert den Cache beim Beenden und läd: Saves the cache on shutdown and loads it on the next start, so the server starts with a warm cache. With very large caches, shutting down can take longer; if the operating system kills the process, the state is lost.
Manuell blockierte Domains und Blocklist: Manage manually blocked domains and block lists in the Filter section.
Domains aus den blockierten Domains und: Domains from the blocked domains and the block lists are not resolved.
Beantwortet TXT-Anfragen zu blockierten: Answers TXT queries for blocked domains with a report about the reason. In addition, every blocking response contains an Extended DNS Error (RFC 8914) if the client supports EDNS.
Eigener Text für den Extended DNS Error: Custom text for the Extended DNS Error and the TXT report, for example Blocked by Example DNS: {domain}. Placeholders: {domain} for the blocked domain, {list} for the block list URL, {source} for the source. Leave empty for the default text.
IP-Adressen oder Netze, eine pro Zeile,: IP addresses or networks, one per line, for which nothing is ever blocked.
Antwortet, als existiere die Domain nich: Answers as if the domain did not exist.
Antwortet mit den folgenden IP-Adressen,: Answers with the following IP addresses, for example to redirect to a notice page.
Wie lange Clients Blockierantworten mit: How long clients cache blocking responses with addresses (null address, custom addresses) and the TXT report.
NXDOMAIN- und NODATA-Blockierantworten e: NXDOMAIN and NODATA blocking responses contain an SOA record. This value is its TTL and MINIMUM and determines how long clients and downstream resolvers cache the response negatively according to RFC 2308. Primary server and contact in the SOA come from the server domain name and the contact address under Server.
Browser fragen bestimmte Domains ab, um: Browsers query certain domains to find out whether they may bypass the network's resolver. If this resolver answers them with NXDOMAIN, the browsers stay with it. Both options work regardless of whether blocking is enabled and show up as blocked in the statistics.
Beantwortet die Canary-Domain <code>use-: Answers the canary domain use-application-dns.net with NXDOMAIN. Firefox then no longer switches to a partner provider's DNS-over-HTTPS on its own and keeps using this resolver including its block lists. If someone enabled DoH in Firefox themselves, it stays enabled.
Chrome: Preflight-Modus für vorab gelade: Chrome: enforce preflight mode for prefetched pages
Beantwortet <code>dns-tunnel-check.googl: Answers dns-tunnel-check.googlezip.net with NXDOMAIN. Otherwise Chrome prefetches pages via Google's Private Prefetch Proxy without asking this resolver. In preflight mode, Chrome additionally checks here before opening a prefetched page, so block lists apply to it as well.
Der Serverdomainname und alle Namen im T: The server domain name and all names in the TLS certificate are automatically on the allow list, including subdomains. Otherwise lists such as HaGeZi's DoH bypass could block your own DoH or DoT host name. A name without a dot, such as a plain host name, is not taken into account.
Listen werden heruntergeladen, zusammeng: Lists are downloaded, merged and kept in memory. About 1 million domains need roughly 80 MB of RAM; temporarily twice that during an update.
Eine URL pro Zeile. Verstanden werden ho: One URL per line. Understood are hosts files, plain domain lists and *.domain (each including subdomains) as well as the AdGuard Home and Adblock rule syntax: ||domain^, exceptions with @@, |domain^ for exactly this domain, ||*.domain^ for subdomains only, * wildcards, regular expressions /…/ and the modifiers $important, $badfilter, $dnstype and $denyallow. Lists in Pi-hole regex format (one expression per line, optionally ;querytype=) work as well. IP addresses and networks such as 192.0.2.1 or 198.51.100.0/24 block responses whose A or AAAA records point to them. Local files can be included via file:///path/to/list.txt. A leading ! turns the list into an allow list, # disables a line. The quick selection offers the HaGeZi lists in Adblock format from the build mirror hagezi-mirror.dnsbunker.org, which publishes every new version immediately, roughly every 4 to 8 hours. From the “Multi” group one level is enough, the Threat Intelligence Feeds complement it.
Änderungen in dieser Tabelle (aktiv, Nam: Changes in this table (active, name, remove) are saved immediately. “Checked” is the last download attempt, “Changed” the last download with new content. Changes to the list URLs above appear here after saving.
Anfragen, die ein öffentlicher Resolver: Queries a public resolver does not need
Diese Regeln greifen vor jeder weiteren: These rules apply before any further processing and before the DNS apps. Over UDP, matching queries are silently dropped so that the server does not serve as a reflector for attacks with spoofed source addresses. Over TCP, TLS, HTTPS and QUIC the server answers with REFUSED, because dropping there would tear down the whole connection including other queries. Queries from loopback addresses are exempt, for example from the DNS client of this web interface. The numbers next to the rules show the hits since start.
Pakete, die sich nicht vollständig lesen: Packets that cannot be read completely or contain no question or several questions instead of exactly one. Without this rule the server answers with FORMERR. Packets shorter than 12 bytes are always dropped.
NOTIFY, UPDATE, IQUERY, STATUS und DSO r: NOTIFY, UPDATE, IQUERY, STATUS and DSO are meant for authoritative servers. Without this rule the server answers with NOTIMP.
CHAOS- und HESIOD-Abfragen wie <code>ver: CHAOS and HESIOD queries such as version.bind mainly serve to probe server details. Without this rule the server answers with REFUSED.
ANY erzeugt große Antworten und ist ein: ANY produces large responses and is a classic tool for amplification attacks (RFC 8482). Without this rule the server asks for a retry over TCP when queried over UDP.
Ein Resolver hostet keine Zonen, die sic: A resolver hosts no zones that could be transferred. Without this rule the server answers with REFUSED.
Ohne Rekursionswunsch fragen nur autorit: Queries without recursion desired only come from authoritative servers or tools that spy on the cache (cache snooping). Without this rule the server only answers local records of forwarder zones.
Es gibt nur EDNS-Version 0; höhere Versi: Only EDNS version 0 exists; higher versions practically only come from scanners. Without this rule the server answers with BADVERS according to RFC 6891.
Größere Anfragen werden verworfen. Norma: Larger queries are dropped. Normal queries are well below 512 bytes, even with EDNS padding for encrypted protocols; 1232 bytes match the recommended EDNS buffer size.
Auch über UDP mit REFUSED antworten stat: Answer with REFUSED over UDP as well instead of dropping
Nur sinnvoll in internen Netzen, in dene: Only useful in internal networks where clients expect an answer. Keep it off on a public resolver.
Anfragen von Adressen auf diesen Listen: Queries from addresses on these lists are dropped without an answer, over UDP even before the query is parsed. TCP, DoT, DoQ and DoH connections are closed immediately. Supported are lists with individual IP addresses or networks in CIDR notation, also with extra columns as in IPsum or Spamhaus DROP. Loopback and the rate limiting exceptions are never blocked.
IPsum Level 3 – auf mindestens drei Sper: IPsum level 3 – on at least three block lists (recommended)
IPsum Level 2 – mehr Treffer, mehr Fehla: IPsum level 2 – more hits, more false positives
IPsum Level 4 – nur sehr häufig gemeldet: IPsum level 4 – only very frequently reported addresses
IPsum Level 5 – nur die auffälligsten Ad: IPsum level 5 – only the most conspicuous addresses
Spamhaus DROP – gekaperte und kriminelle: Spamhaus DROP – hijacked and criminal IPv4 networks

Der DHCP-Server vergibt IPv4-Adressen un: The DHCP server hands out IPv4 addresses and adds the names of the devices to the local DNS. It detects other DHCP servers in the network and can give them priority.

Mehrere Adressen mit Leerzeichen trennen: Separate several addresses with spaces. When empty, the server hands out its own address in the respective network, so the devices use ZenitiumDNS with all filters.
